products.name: Premium Dairy Cattle Feed 50 kg
products.shortDescription: 20 percent protein pellet feed for milking cows and buffaloes.
products.description: Balanced compound feed made from maize, de-oiled rice bran, soya and mineral mix. Fed at 1 kg for every 2.5 litres of milk, it helps keep fat percentage steady through the lactation. Packed in a moisture-proof 50 kg bag.

products.name: Calf Starter Pellets 20 kg
products.shortDescription: High energy starter for calves from week two to six months.
products.description: Palatable crumble with 22 percent protein, added vitamins A, D3, E and probiotics. Helps calves switch to solid feed early and supports steady weight gain.

products.name: Bypass Fat Supplement 5 kg
products.shortDescription: Rumen bypass fat for high yielding cows in early lactation.
products.description: Prilled calcium salt of palm fatty acids. Supplies extra energy without upsetting rumen function, useful during the first 100 days after calving when cows lose body condition.

products.name: Chelated Mineral Mixture 5 kg
products.shortDescription: Area specific mineral mix with zinc, copper and selenium.
products.description: Chelated minerals absorb better than inorganic salts. Improves fertility, hoof health and immunity. Mix 50 g per day per adult animal with the concentrate.

products.name: Cotton Seed Cake 50 kg
products.shortDescription: Whole cottonseed cake from our own crushing unit.
products.description: High protein, high energy cake that works well with green fodder. Kept dry and free of aflatoxin by testing every batch. Sold directly from the farm godown.

products.name: Wheat Straw (Bhusa) Bale 40 kg
products.shortDescription: Clean, dry wheat bhusa pressed into compact bales.
products.description: Harvested this season and stored under cover. Free of dust and mould. Good roughage base for dry cows and heifers.

products.name: Napier Grass Cuttings 1 tonne
products.shortDescription: Fresh cut hybrid Napier, delivered within 24 hours.
products.description: Cut at 45 to 60 days for best protein. Chopped on request. Delivery by tractor within 40 km of Nashik.

products.name: Maize Silage 40 kg Bag
products.shortDescription: Fermented whole plant maize silage, sealed bags.
products.description: Made from sweet corn plants chopped at dough stage and fermented for 60 days. Smells sweet, not sour. Open bag lasts about four days.

products.name: Dung Cake (Goitha) Pack of 50
products.shortDescription: Sun dried cow dung cakes for havan and fuel.
products.description: Hand made from desi cow dung, dried for two weeks in open sun. Each cake is about 12 cm across. Suitable for puja, havan and traditional cooking.

products.name: Vermicompost 25 kg
products.shortDescription: Fine sieved earthworm compost for fields and gardens.
products.description: Made from cattle dung and farm waste with Eisenia fetida. Moisture around 30 percent, pH near neutral. Improves soil structure and water holding.

products.name: Well Rotted Cow Dung Manure 500 kg
products.shortDescription: Two year old cow dung manure, ready to apply.
products.description: Stacked and turned for over two years, no smell and no weed seeds. Sold by the trolley load in Bikaner district.

products.name: Stainless Steel Cattle Water Trough 100 L
products.shortDescription: 304 grade steel trough with drain plug.
products.description: Rust free, easy to clean, rounded edges so animals cannot hurt themselves. Comes with a bottom drain plug and welded legs. Size 120 x 45 x 30 cm.

products.name: FMD Vaccine 50 Dose Vial
products.shortDescription: Trivalent oil adjuvant vaccine against foot and mouth disease.
products.description: Protects against serotypes O, A and Asia 1. Dose is 2 ml by deep intramuscular injection. Keep refrigerated at 2 to 8 degrees. Sold to farmers with a vet prescription.

products.name: Brucella S19 Vaccine 10 Dose
products.shortDescription: Live vaccine for female calves aged 4 to 8 months.
products.description: One time vaccination for calves. Handle with gloves and follow disposal instructions. Not for adult animals or pregnant cows.

products.name: Ivermectin Injection 30 ml
products.shortDescription: Broad spectrum treatment for worms, lice and mange.
products.description: Dose 1 ml per 50 kg body weight under the skin. Milk withdrawal period 28 days. Use only as advised by a veterinarian.

products.name: Calcium Gluconate Bolus Pack of 10
products.shortDescription: Oral calcium boluses for the days around calving.
products.description: Helps prevent milk fever in high yielding cows. Give two boluses at calving and two twelve hours later. Keep in a cool dry place.

products.name: Electric Milking Machine 2 Bucket
products.shortDescription: Portable twin bucket machine for up to 20 animals.
products.description: Oil free vacuum pump, stainless steel buckets of 25 litres each, silicone liners and pulsator. One year warranty. Includes spare liner set and a printed Hindi manual.

products.name: Chaff Cutter 2 HP Motor
products.shortDescription: Heavy duty chaff cutter with copper winding motor.
products.description: Cuts green and dry fodder from 10 to 40 mm. Cast iron body, three blades, safety guard. Single phase 220 V.

products.name: Aluminium Milk Can 40 Litre
products.shortDescription: Food grade aluminium can with tight lid.
products.description: Standard dairy can used for milk collection and transport. Smooth inner finish, riveted handles, flat bottom. Capacity 40 litres.

products.name: Cattle Grooming Brush Set
products.shortDescription: Stiff and soft brushes with a rubber curry comb.
products.description: Three piece set for daily grooming. Removes dust and loose hair, improves blood circulation and keeps the coat clean before milking.

products.name: Udder Wash and Teat Dip 5 L
products.shortDescription: Iodine based post milking teat dip with skin conditioner.
products.description: Dip each teat for 10 seconds after every milking. Helps lower new mastitis infections. Does not stain milk when used as directed.

products.name: Rubber Cow Mat 6 x 4 ft
products.shortDescription: 18 mm thick anti slip stall mat.
products.description: Reduces knee and hock injuries, keeps the cow dry and warm, and is easy to wash. Weight about 36 kg.

products.name: Neem Herbal Fly Repellent Spray 1 L
products.shortDescription: Neem and citronella spray for cattle sheds.
products.description: Plant based spray that keeps flies and mosquitoes away from animals and sheds. Spray on walls, drains and the animal's body line.
products.rejectionReason: Please add the licence number and ingredient list to the description, then resubmit.

products.name: Adult Dog Food Chicken and Rice 10 kg
products.shortDescription: Complete dry food for adult dogs, farm dog friendly.
products.description: Real chicken as the first ingredient, rice for easy digestion, with omega 3 and 6. Suitable for adult dogs of all breeds that guard the farm.

products.name: Adjustable Dog Collar and Leash Set
products.shortDescription: Padded nylon collar with a 1.5 m leash.
products.description: Reflective stitching for night visibility, quick release buckle and a stainless steel ring. Fits neck sizes 30 to 50 cm.
